title: Checkpoint: Units 0-3
description: Mixed review of Units 0-3, after the Unit 3 final test.

items.question: Which number do you hear?
items.explanation: Unit 0: German says the ones first: sieben-und-sechzig = 7 and 60 = 67.

items.question: You walk into a bakery in Munich at 10 a.m. Which greeting fits best?
items.explanation: Unit 0: Grüß Gott is the usual hello in Bavaria and Austria. Gute Nacht and Tschüss are goodbyes.

items.question: You leave a doctor's office. Which goodbye is polite?
items.explanation: Unit 0: Auf Wiedersehen is the polite goodbye. Hallo and Guten Abend are greetings.
Unit 0: Ich verstehe nicht. Then ask: Noch einmal, bitte!

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Where are you from? (informal)
items.explanation: Unit 1: du kommst. Answer with aus: Ich komme aus Armenien.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: He is a teacher.
items.explanation: Unit 1: er ist. Jobs come without ein: Er ist Lehrer.
Units 1 and 3: the verb is always second. With heute first, ich moves behind the verb.

items.question: Which article goes with Kind?
items.explanation: Unit 2: das Kind, plural die Kinder.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I don't have a key.
items.explanation: Unit 2: der Schlüssel is masculine, so keinen after haben.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: two books
items.explanation: Unit 2: das Buch, die Bücher (umlaut plus -er).

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: This is my sister.
items.explanation: Unit 2: die Schwester is feminine, so meine Schwester.

items.audio: Der Termin ist am Donnerstag um Viertel nach elf.
items.question: When is the appointment?
items.explanation: Unit 3: Viertel nach elf = quarter past eleven, 11:15. Donnerstag = Thursday, Dienstag = Tuesday.

items.instruction: Fill in the gaps: In the evening I watch TV.
items.explanation: Unit 3: fernsehen splits: sehe in second place, fern at the end.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: She has to work today.
items.explanation: Unit 3: sie muss, with no ending, the same as ich muss. arbeiten waits at the end.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: on the third of October
items.explanation: Unit 3: dritte is irregular; after am the ending is -ten: am dritten Oktober.

items.instruction: Checkpoint writing. Introduce yourself to a new classmate in 5-6 sentences: your name, where you're from, where you live, your job, your family, and one plan for this week (Am Samstag will ich ...). Claude will check it.
items.prompt: Introduce yourself to a new classmate.
